affected_boundaries: Conditional test registration and runtime validation

observed_behavior: Four executed database tests were rejected as non-executable because their enclosing suites used environment-gated describe.runIf.
expected_behavior: Retain conditional test declarations while excluding statically disabled registrations and requiring actual enabled test results for completeness credit.
causal_mechanism: The runner locator marked every runIf and skipIf property disabled without examining the supplied condition.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Static discovery conflated conditional registration with an observed skipped execution.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Even runIf(true) and environment-enabled database suites were rejected before runtime evidence could be considered.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Declaration eligibility and passing execution are separate facts.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Inspect conditional registration calls, reject statically disabling boolean conditions, preserve enclosing disabled suites, and leave dynamic execution proof to validation and adequacy review.

applicability_conditions: Recognized test runner conditional methods gate tests or enclosing suites.
known_non_matches: Explicit skip/todo and statically disabled boolean gates remain ineligible.
confirmation_evidence: An identical marked suite passed as plain describe but failed with describe.runIf(true), false or an environment condition.
The new regression failed for runIf(true) before the correction and passed afterward.
regression_proofs: tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: conditional runner declarations retain links without asserting runtime execution
tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: custom suite opt-in preserves skipped enclosing suite exclusion
